plan.title: Adopt per-content-class naming conventions and migrate the library

narratives.Overview: Filenames carry identity; the database carries description. Today's convention has this backwards - it encodes tags, the most mutable field in the model, so re-tagging a video renames a file.
narratives.Problem: Renaming is the operation most likely to orphan data. Attaching it to the most frequently edited field is the wrong trade - invisible at 10 videos, expensive at 2,101.
narratives.Action:
Adopt open standards where they exist; define a grammar only for scenes, where none does.

- Film: Title (Year)/Title (Year).ext (Kodi/Plex)
- Episodic: Series/Season NN/Series - SxxEyy - Title.ext (Kodi/Plex)
- Scene: Studio/Studio - Performers - YYYY-MM-DD.ext (ViLM-defined)

Asset gains a contentKind field. Delimiters do NOT change: ' - ' between fields, ', ' between performers - both legal on every filesystem in play.
narratives.Constraint:
BLOCKED on release-date capture. The date is the field that motivates the change; renaming now and again later doubles the risk for no benefit.

The library volume is ExFAT, chosen for cross-platform readability. Pipe is legal on macOS but forbidden on Windows, and would fail silently until the drive is moved.
narratives.Risk:
The migration is the dangerous half and now MOVES files between folders, not just renames them: a partial run leaves two layouts coexisting, cross-filesystem moves are copy-then-delete rather than atomic, and every asset's path changes in the catalog.

Dry-run, resumable and reversible are mandatory. The reversal mapping must record full paths, not names. Classification must be reviewable before any write - a misclassification renames a file into the wrong grammar, destroying the identity the rename existed to encode.
narratives.Test: T1 round-trip including delimiters and non-ASCII. T2 no orphaning. T3 dry run writes nothing. T4 interruption leaves every file fully migrated or untouched, never half. T5 reversibility. T7 length ceiling truncates deterministically at a field boundary.
narratives.Source: Spec D2, D6, D7, D11, D12, D14. Measured 2026-08-03 across 2,101 files.
